_meta.rules: Pre-start harness retarget to MCP/STDIO approved. After this point, do not remove features. Only update passes after running the truth gate. Add new features at the end. 'risk' is required: low/medium/high.

features.description: Repo has pyproject.toml, src layout, and installs cleanly with uv/pip
plan: Create pyproject.toml with project metadata and dev dependencies
Create src/goose_mail/__init__.py and src/goose_mail/__main__.py
Run: uv pip install -e '.[dev]' or pip install -e '.[dev]'
Run: python -c 'import goose_mail; print(goose_mail.__version__)'

features.description: Ruff lint passes across the codebase with zero errors
plan: Add ruff config to pyproject.toml
Run: ruff check .

features.description: pytest runs and at least one smoke test passes
plan: Create tests/test_smoke.py
Run: pytest -v

features.description: MCP server boots locally with one stub tool and no crash over STDIO
plan: Add MCP server dependency and server bootstrap
Implement one safe stub tool such as ping or list_accounts returning static data
Create __main__.py entrypoint
Verify import/bootstrap with tests and a local launch smoke check

features.description: Goose Desktop can load the extension as a STDIO custom extension and expose the stub tool
plan: Document the absolute command path for Goose Desktop
Add a sample extension config/example command
Manual verify in Goose Desktop that the tool is visible

features.description: Read-only IMAP configuration layer implemented with account validation and provider profiles
plan: Add config models for accounts
Support generic, Gmail, Outlook, and IONOS profile presets
Load secrets from env vars only
Test config validation without real credentials

features.description: Read-only mail tools implemented: list_accounts, list_folders, search_mail, read_message
plan: Implement IMAP client wrapper
Implement MIME parsing and HTML-to-text fallback
Normalize message/search outputs
Test with mocks and fixtures only

features.description: SMTP send_mail implemented with structured success/error results and safe logging
plan: Implement SMTP send_mail
Return structured results only
Do not support attachments in first pass unless trivial
Test with mocks and document manual self-send smoke test
